name: Dual Chroma: Haereticus
source:
As a scribe, you serve in subterranean tombs. You once adored a different version of Him before His transformation. Now, as He calls you to the Cerean Hall, how will you respond?

A glimpse into the shadows of Aradal ages past.

[from [url=https://galengames.itch.io/dual-chroma-haereticus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为抄写员，你在地下坟墓中服务。在他转变之前，你曾经崇拜他的不同版本。现在，当他召唤你到塞林大厅时，你会如何回应？

一睹阿拉达尔时代过去的阴影。
